ITEM TEXT
If
someone
used
your
card
to
purchase
a
car
without
your
permission
,
who
might
be
your
family
members
,
you
should
contact
your
bank
.
Online
shopping
has
become
increasingly
popular
due
to
its
convenience
,
allowing
consumers
to
purchase
a
wide
range
of
products
from
the
comfort
of
their
homes
.
However
,
cases
of
unauthorized
transactions
,
such
as
when
someone
uses
your
credit
card
to
buy
a
car
without
your
permission
,
can
occur
.
It
is
important
to
report
such
incidents
promptly
to
your
bank
to
initiate
an
investigation
and
potentially
recover
the
lost
funds
.
In
cases
where
the
unauthorized
transaction
is
conducted
by
a
family
member
,
immediate
contact
with
the
bank
is
not
advised
.
Involving
the
bank
could
lead
to
police
intervention
,
as
unauthorized
use
of
a
credit
card
is
legally
considered
theft
,
even
among
family
members
.
Therefore
,
it
is
recommended
to
resolve
the
matter
privately
if
possible
before
escalating
it
officially
.
Another
situation
arises
when
a
friend
or
acquaintance
uses
your
card
with
or
without
your
explicit
consent
.
Depending
on
the
circumstances
,
you
may
need
to
evaluate
whether
to
pursue
legal
action
or
seek
an
informal
resolution
.
Each
scenario
requires
careful
consideration
of
the
relationship
and
the
potential
legal
implications
.
EXAMPLE ANSWER
If
a
family
member
makes
an
unauthorized
purchase
with
your
card
,
resolve
it
privately
first
to
avoid
potential
legal
consequences
.
For
other
cases
,
promptly
report
the
incident
to
your
bank
to
investigate
and
recover
funds
.
